# Democrate - Sanskar Global School

> Democrate is an anonymous complaint and feedback platform for Sanskar Global School, designed to help students report concerns safely.

## Navigation
- [Student Portal](/#/login/student) - Submit complaints anonymously
- [Teacher Portal](/#/login/teacher) - Verify complaints and view ratings
- [Admin Portal](/#/login/admin) - Moderate and resolve issues

## Usage guidelines
This site is a private application for Sanskar Global School. Unauthorized scraping or automated submission of complaints is strictly prohibited.
